simple.meaning: חָסֹן (châçôn) is a Hebrew word meaning “powerful.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָסֹן (H2634) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 1:31, with occurrences in Isaiah, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָסֹן (H2634) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָסֹן (H2634) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָסֹן (châçôn) / H2634 is traced through Isaiah 1:31, Amos 2:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
